html:
About Us

A Dental Office That Does More

At Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport, our general, cosmetic, restorative, and emergency dentist in Kansas City, MO exceeds our patients' expectations. We're the top choice for patients who want more from their dental visits and care. We believe every patient deserves a unique, personal, and outstanding experience at the dental office. We treat individuals and families of all ages and oral health backgrounds in a warm, accommodating environment. Using the latest tools and technology, we fulfill everything from minor cosmetic treatments to emergency care and produce exceptional results. We'll comfort you throughout your treatment or procedure. You'll leave with a smile you absolutely love.
Contact Us

In-Depth and Customized Dental Care

We believe in harnessing the most up-to-date and innovative technology to achieve excellent results. Our services include performing oral exams and teeth cleanings and implementing top-quality fillings, mouth guards, implants, crowns, bridges, veneers, clear aligners, and beyond. We also conduct advanced treatments for patients suffering from sleep apnea and jaw alignment disorders, helping them feel more comfortable in their lives. With state-of-the-art technology like X-ray imaging, we can carefully evaluate, diagnose, and treat virtually any oral health condition. Whether you want straighter, brighter, or healthier teeth, we will provide you with the perfect personalized treatments and solutions.

Going Above and Beyond for Your Teeth

Your teeth are among the most important parts of your body. Without them, you wouldn't be able to eat, drink, and sustain your daily life. You couldn't light up a room and make a great first impression. Though brushing and flossing daily significantly reduces the risks of decay and diseases, professional treatment is needed to keep your mouth in optimal condition. We are genuinely passionate about our patients' smiles and well-being. Regardless of the size or scope of your condition, you can expect Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport to provide the highest quality care at each step of your dental experience.

Choose Us for the Perfect Smile

Call Now
